brand.name: Ads Studio
brand.aesthetic: Magazine-grade editorial, Swiss design, Brutalist minimal, confident, raw structure. Pentagram / Linear inspired.

rules.labels: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-muted_text

spacing_and_layout.system: Tailwind generously spaced: p-8, p-12, p-24.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento 'Control Room' grid (strict, dense, functional). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Asymmetry preferred for marketing moments, strict columns for dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment. No 'center-everything'. Optical alignment for icons.

surfaces_and_microthemes.global: Flat, sharp edges, no soft drop-shadows. Use 1px solid borders to define structure (border-border).
surfaces_and_microthemes.cards: bg-white border border-border p-8. Hover: border-black transition-colors.
surfaces_and_microthemes.modals: Solid white background, strict black border, brutalist backdrop (bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm).
surfaces_and_microthemes.buttons: Rectangular (rounded-none). Primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-900. Accent/CTA: bg-[#E52514] text-white hover:bg-red-700.

components_strategy.workspace_dashboard: Grid of created brand projects. Use strict tabular layouts or large bento cards. Empty state: Massive typography and minimal abstract editorial image.
components_strategy.drop_url_input: Massive full-width input. font-mono, text-2xl or 3xl. border-b-2 border-black, no side/top borders. Focus: border-[#E52514] and zero outline. Add an icon indicating 'Enter' to submit.
components_strategy.wizard_3_step: Full-screen takeover or massive modal. Large counter (1/3) in font-mono. Step content uses large headings.
components_strategy.brand_identity_card: A beautiful artifact. Shows color swatches in stark geometric blocks, font pairings dynamically, and tone descriptors in mono tags.
components_strategy.ad_creatives_grid: 15 images generated. 3-column or 4-column masonry or strict square grid. gap-px (1px grid lines between images) to look like a raw contact sheet.
components_strategy.byok_modal: Settings panel for API keys. Standard Shadcn inputs but with rounded-none and 1px sharp borders. Clear 'Test' button.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Explicit text and border color changes. E.g., hover:border-black, hover:text-black.
interactions_and_motion.loaders: ASCII art loaders or rapid mono-text scrambling. No generic spinners.

image_urls.description: Minimalist editorial photo for empty workspace inspiration.
Modern typography poster as a generated ad fallback.

technical_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
technical_rules.shadcn: Strip ALL border-radius from Shadcn components. Force 1px borders everywhere. Override card padding to p-8 or p-12.
technical_rules.storage: Keys in localStorage. Brands/Ads in MongoDB.
technical_rules.icons: lucide-react with stroke-width 1.5 for a sharp, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a strict, magazine-grade creative tool. Avoid all 'SaaS' cliches (no soft shadows, no rounded corners, no gradients). Everything should feel like a printed layout or a high-end architect's blueprint. Use pure white, deep black, and sharp red for accents. Implement the BYOK modal first to allow testing the Anthropic/Fal APIs. Build the dashboard next, followed by the wizard and generation pipeline.
